voice.speaker: female
voice.effect:
Too many little thoughts up there, Sissy? Turn them into static.
A warm hum... a soft hiss... every thought dissolving into it.
Sissies like you melt into that hum and sink.
Sissy Drop.
Warm static... and you sink right through it. That's it. Warm static... and the thoughts dissolve with you. Good girl. Warm static... empty head... heavy body... deeper. Warm static... the hum carries you all the way down. Warm static... nothing left to think at all. Warm static... soft, fuzzy, sinking quiet. Warm static... deeper than the hum, deeper still. Warm static... and my voice at the bottom of it.
